text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today is the Spring Fan Appreciation 
Festival! It's a day where Umamusume 
entertain their fans through various fun 
events, but—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Huh... "Trainer Three-Legged Race"!? What 
is that!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"...It's just as the name suggests. You 
run the course three-legged with your 
trainer."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Blow past them and win. That's all.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
No, that's not what I mean... Why was I 
even entered into that kind of event in 
the first place?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...You must've skipped out and been absent 
when we were deciding events.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Oof.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
There wasn't a single entry submitted for 
any events. But you must participate in at 
least one.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
That is why the Student Council decided on 
it. Do you have an objection?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Ah... It's there! Then why, of all 
things...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Sis told me that if I didn't want you 
slacking off, putting you together with 
your trainee was the quickest way.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...You've taken quite a liking to it, 
haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Nnnngh...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Your right foot is fine, right?! Then I'm 
gonna tie it!! Jeez, let's just get this 
over with...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I ended up running a three-legged race 
with a noticeably grumpy Narita 
Taishin...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume on Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And now, the "Trainer Three-Legged Race"! 
Ready—GO!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: One, two, one, two—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!? Wait, no way, she's fast even like 
this!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She's holding back quite a bit, but she's 
still an Umamusume. It's not a speed I can 
just match on the fly...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, at this rate, I'm going to 
lose...!
choice_data_list:
Don't worry about me, go full throttle, 
Taishin!
Don't worry about me, go all out, Taishin!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh!? But then you'll—
choice_data_list: I'll match it no matter what it takes!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Don't blame me if something happens!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, moving my legs frantically—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, she noticed.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Geez... I told you so, didn't I? Overdoing 
it like an idiot.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (CRACK!!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Full body muscle soreness. Naturally.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Here, lie on your stomach. I'll loosen up 
those muscles for you.
choice_data_list: Huh, you don't have to go that far—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I—said—it's—fine!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Narita Taishin helped loosen up my 
stiff body, but...
choice_data_list:
Ow-ow-ow, it hurts, it hurts, be 
gentler...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: No way, idiot!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...For someone who always pushes herself 
too hard, this is just the right amount, 
I'm telling you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as I panicked and tried to pick up 
the pace—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Take it easy. ...Don't push yourself, go 
slow!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Take it easy for now. Just match my pace 
on the final stretch.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
That's all we need to catch up. —With your 
late kick and mine!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume on Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, we're finally in the final stretch!! 
Which pair will cross the finish line 
first?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: “—Let's go! One-two, one-two!”

text_block_list.name: Umamusume on Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, what's this?! The one showing a 
ferocious surge from behind is the Narita 
Taishin pair!!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume on Commentary
text_block_list.text:
What a phenomenal closing burst!? Blowing 
past the competition in an instant—she 
crosses the finish line!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Waaaaah!! Go get 'em, Taishin pair~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*. I think... that might've 
been more exhausting than any race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'm as exhausted as can be. I don't feel 
like I can move for a while...
choice_data_list:
(Still, that speed I felt in the final 
stretch—)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? What're you staring at?
choice_data_list: Taishin's final push really is incredible.
Taishin's final push really is incredible.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
What are you saying all of a sudden... 
Dummy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Somehow, it felt like a truly valuable 
experience...
